title: Disruptive Innovators Network — Eric in conversation with Ezechi Britton MBE at Salesforce Tower on Incorruptible
summary: Disruptive Innovators Network (UK housing-sector innovation forum) hosts Eric in conversation with Ezechi Britton MBE at the top of Salesforce Tower on September 11 — an exclusive DIN-members event closing Eric's UK tour week. Every delegate receives a copy of Incorruptible courtesy of Fusion21.
blockquote: So we're delighted that on 11 September at Salesforce, Eric will be joining us for an exclusive event for DIN members, in conversation with Ezechi Britton MBE, where he'll explore what it takes to build a successful business and then keep it there.
